background: OSB Group is a UK specialist lender formed from OneSavings Bank and Charter Court, funded by retail savings under the Kent Reliance and Charter Savings brands and lending mainly on buy-to-let and professional-landlord mortgages.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, BBB on average, both on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 16 May 2023. CET1 of 15.2% is above the median for UK mid-sized banks, while leverage of 7.1% is below it; both have slipped since 30 Jun 2025, CET1 by 0.5 points and leverage by 0.4 points. Liquidity is sound, with LCR of 172% and NSFR of 140% at or above the peer median and broadly flat. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
